main.summary: Durable state record for recovering a transfer publication across process failures.

property.name: Created
property.summary: UTC timestamp when the publication journal was created.

property.name: ExpectedStateVersion
property.summary: Transfer-session state version expected when the publication operation began.

property.name: CatalogName
property.summary: Configured catalog name used to resolve current publication storage credentials.

property.name: Family
property.summary: Transfer family whose publication operation is being recovered.

property.name: FinalObjectInfo
property.summary: Optional final object metadata supplied for stream completion.

property.name: FinalObjectPayload
property.summary: Optional final serialized object payload supplied for stream completion.

property.name: FinalStreamLength
property.summary: Optional final stream length supplied for stream completion.

property.name: Integrity
property.summary: Optional server-authoritative ordered integrity summary captured for the publication.

property.name: FailureCount
property.summary: Cumulative number of recovery failures recorded for this operation.

property.name: ItemID
property.summary: Immutable data item identifier associated with the publication.

property.name: ItemInstanceToken
property.summary: Catalog-owned item instance token associated with the publication.

property.name: LastError
property.summary: Most recent recoverable error associated with the publication operation.

property.name: OperationID
property.summary: Stable identifier for the publication operation across retries and process restarts.

property.name: Phase
property.summary: Durable phase reached by the publication workflow.

property.name: SessionID
property.summary: Transfer session identifier associated with the publication.

property.name: Updated
property.summary: UTC timestamp when the journal was most recently updated.
